findings.issue: וְשָׁפְטוּ is qal sequential perfect 3rd common plural; juzgará is 3rd singular. The subject הָעֵדָה is one feminine singular congregation, so the singular verb is Spanish agreement with that collective and does not change the participant.

notes: entre…y entre, el hiriente, el redentor de la sangre, and sobre los juicios estos match the remaining tokens.
